role_reviews.objection: C002 proves a row limit only after fixing n; every Abel/Laguerre constant may depend on n.
role_reviews.recommendation: Retain C002 exactly and demand a quantitative remainder with explicit n-dependence before using Y_n.

role_reviews.objection: The Laguerre degree grows with n, so a fixed-degree tail estimate cannot be read as uniform asymptotics.
role_reviews.recommendation: Expose validity regions and constants, then compare the resulting modulus with the n^(5/3) log^2 cutoff.

role_reviews.objection: The natural-order endpoint, outer complement, and all internal prefixes are three different control surfaces.
role_reviews.recommendation: Reject reordering and require separate endpoint, prefix-maximal, and complement obligations.

role_reviews.objection: forall n exists M(n,epsilon) does not imply that a prescribed Y_n eventually exceeds M(n,epsilon_n).
role_reviews.recommendation: Write source and target quantifiers side by side and require a witnessed modulus/diagonal comparison.

role_reviews.objection: Y_n tending to infinity is compatible with a row threshold growing still faster.

existence of a diagonal-compatible modulus at epsilon_n and Y_n
